knowledge.name: Synthetic seasonal event snapshot
knowledge.detail: Four fictional in-game events with plan, launch pack, launch day, milestones, latest update, and gaps.

knowledge.name: Cross-team launch tasks
knowledge.detail: Eight fictional tasks with team, owner, status, reminder flag, and source across the four events.

knowledge.name: Player announcement records
knowledge.detail: Four per-event announcements with messaging, approval, publish permission, brief, and gaps.

knowledge.name: Launch rules and guardrails
knowledge.detail: Routing, evidence, and no-publishing rules bundled as a synthetic knowledge file.

intelligence_processing.name: Milestone timeline assembly
intelligence_processing.detail: Orders each event's milestones to launch day and names the first milestone and latest team update.

intelligence_processing.name: Readiness rollup by team
intelligence_processing.detail: Lists every task with team, owner, status, and source and counts complete tasks against the total.

intelligence_processing.name: Announcement publish check
intelligence_processing.detail: Allows publishing only when messaging is approved and permission is granted; otherwise holds it.

intelligence_processing.name: Late, missing, and blocked triage
intelligence_processing.detail: Counts late, missing, and blocked tasks and drafts owner reminders that are never sent.

intelligence_processing.name: Fail-closed event resolution
intelligence_processing.detail: Resolves an event by key or name, defaults to the demo event, and never substitutes an unknown one.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio launch experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Hosts the pilot with four skills and two synthetic knowledge files; the package stays Draft until review.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs the single-file LiveEventLaunchPlannerAgent locally with deterministic event routing.

management_reporting.name: Launch timeline table
management_reporting.detail: Launch day, plan, launch pack, first milestone, every milestone, and anything missing.

management_reporting.name: Readiness checklist
management_reporting.detail: Task, team, owner, status, reminder needed, and source, with tasks complete out of the total.

management_reporting.name: Launch status summary
management_reporting.detail: Late, missing, and blocked counts, announcement status, and draft reminders for owners.

management_reporting.name: Launch acceptance evidence
management_reporting.detail: Four locked live operations, community, and marketing cases, one per operation.

tools.name: Portable LiveEventLaunchPlannerAgent
tools.detail: Single-file Python BasicAgent with four deterministic read-only operations over synthetic launches.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the four-skill package; publishing needs an authorized reviewer.

tools.name: Launch plan tasks and owners
tools.detail: Cited read-only seam for plan tasks and owners; no live connection in the package.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams launch channel updates
tools.detail: Cited read-only seam for team updates; the agent never posts or sends a message.

tools.name: Launch materials in Microsoft SharePoint
tools.detail: Cited read-only seam for launch packs and announcement briefs; synthetic records stand in.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic launch evidence boundary
supporting_features.detail: Every event, milestone, task, owner, launch pack, and brief is invented; no browsing or live claims.

supporting_features.name: No publishing or reminders sent
supporting_features.detail: Never publishes an announcement, sends a reminder, changes a task or event, or grants permission.

supporting_features.name: Event owner approval gate
supporting_features.detail: Live operations, community, and marketing leads approve every announcement and reminder.

supporting_features.name: Drafts held until approved
supporting_features.detail: Announcements and reminders are returned as drafts with their approval and permission status.

supporting_features.name: Controlled future writes
supporting_features.detail: Any later write needs authenticated tools, authorization checks, explicit human approval, and an audit log.
